ownWorkReview.extension: No extension release claim is made. This publication shares a website presentation, not a new extension version or store approval.
ownWorkReview.sdk: No SDK release claim is made. The stable SDK update already covered by the newsroom was not republished.

deduplication.reason: The presentation is already a substantive seven-language website resource. Adding sender support and social copy is more direct than creating a duplicate news article.

supported: The presentation supports seven website locales.
It covers Nostr identity, signed events, relays, trust, remote signing and Nostr WoT resources.
Readers can navigate with visible controls, keyboard arrows, swipes and a slide selector.
The live page exposes the canonical URL https://nostrwot.com/deck and an Open Graph image.
notMade: The Nostr concepts in the presentation are newly released.
Every Nostr client implements the described flows identically.
The presentation replaces hands-on key backup or client testing.
A new extension or SDK version is available.

linkedin.reason: This is the Nostr WoT team's own substantive 29-slide educational resource, published in seven languages for workshops and onboarding.

nostr.reason: The presentation is directly useful to people teaching or learning how Nostr identity and signing fit together.
